## DeviantArt

**Not bulk-vendored.** Most DA posts are *not* free for games. Only use pieces that explicitly say stock / public domain / commercial OK / free download terms. Prefer OGA + Duelyst + CardArt over random DA rips. See project `ASSET_SOURCES.md`.
